name: heading-anchor-link
title: Heading anchor link
description: The # beside a heading that lets a section be linked to: it copies the URL with the fragment, says so, and works from the keyboard.
docs: The id goes on the heading; without one no link is drawn. offset is the height of a sticky header, as scroll-margin-top. The link is a sibling of the heading, so the heading's own name stays clean for screen readers, and it is named after its heading (label takes {heading}), so a list of links tells them apart.
